title: Small and overpriced
text: Small and overpriced. Wish they'd have made it a little bigger and the price for what it is seems a bit excessive. It does seem like it's decent quality and does work at least. It's easy to use and produces frothy milk like it should.

product_metadata.title: Electric Milk Frother, KOAIKA Coffee Frother Detachable, Milk Frother and Steamer, Frother for Coffee, Cappuccino, Latte, Hot Chocolates and Milk
features: Milk Steamer 4-in-1: KOAIKA milk frother comes with 4 preset modes: cappuccino, latte, hot chocolate, cold. You can get hot airy foam, hot creamy foam, cold foam, and hot chocolate or warm milk. Brew your favorite cappuccino, latte, hot chocolate, macchiato, and flat white at home.

Electric Milk Frother with Big Capacity and Efficient Heating: Milk Frother Electric capacity upgraded up to 8.46 Oz(250ml) for frothing and 11.84 Oz(350ml) for heating milk or make hot chocolate. Milk Warmer: Chocolate mode can help you heating milk or chocolate up to 70±5℃(149-167℉).(Recommended to use whole milk with fat content>3% for the optimal foam)

Frother: Easy to Clean - Milk Foamer Dishwasher-safe jug can be removed from the 360° detachable base for thorough cleaning with a big spout; pay attention to wipe dry the jug bottom and base surface when placing it back.
Quick and Quiet Operation: Electric Frother Heats and prepares exquisite milk foam in less than 2 minutes, frother whisk let you make a beautiful café-style coffee drinks arts.
Durable and Stylish Design: Frother Electric with High-quality stainless steel and non-stick coating interior for hygienic cleaning and a long lifespan; angled spout to minimize spillages.
